description: A snowy night street of grey terrace houses with wrought-iron balconies and a glowing street lamp. Parked cars and a police car with a blue light sit behind blue-and-white tape printed with the word POLICE. On the right, a red-brick building has a lit upper window full of books and a desk lamp, and a shop window below shows guitars. Snow falls. No people, no frame.
reason: The police tape across the street carries legible lettering (POLICE, repeated), and there is a small plate on the left car. Repaint the tape plain, without words.
